title: Certification Services
bodyHtml:
Management System Certification in accordance with ISO 13485

The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission – Medical Devices Division (IPC-MDD) provides management system certification services in accordance with ISO 13485: Medical Devices – Quality management systems – Requirements for regulatory purposes.

IPC-MDD is committed to delivering certification services with a focus on quality, competence, impartiality, and confidentiality, supporting the medical device sector in meeting applicable regulatory and quality management system requirements.

Stakeholders, industry partners, and interested organisations may contact IPC-MDD for further information regarding certification services.
